text:
Michael C Hall, Uma Thurman, Peter Dinklage & More Turn Heads At 'Dexter: Resurrection' Premiere
Michael C Hall, Uma Thurman, Peter Dinklage, Christian Slater, Molly Brown, Patrick Gibson, and the rest of the star-studded cast of the much-anticipated crime drama Dexter: Resurrection attended the show’s grand premiere on Wednesday. Hall returns to his iconic role as Dexter Morgan in this thrilling sequel.
